source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Replace individual handoff reports with a single unit-wide discussion that contains all patient-specific clinical details.","B":"Serve only operating-room teams, because huddles are not intended for inpatient nursing or other healthcare teams.","C":"Wait until a safety problem causes harm before meeting, because huddles are designed for retrospective event analysis.","D":"Update situational awareness, surface emerging concerns, and adjust the team plan proactively as conditions change."}}
source_row.rationale: A huddle is a brief team replanning tool used to restore shared situational awareness, adjust the plan and identify emerging safety/resource needs; it complements rather than replaces patient-specific handoff.
source_row.source_detail: TeamSTEPPS team-event overview describes huddles as ad hoc planning/replanning opportunities used to establish situational awareness, reinforce plans and address emerging issues. Current AHRQ TeamSTEPPS 3.0 curriculum rechecked 2026-08-15. Reviewed 2026-08-15.
source_row.stem: A nursing team conducts a brief huddle to reassess workload, acuity and emerging safety concerns. What is the main purpose?
